story.title: Chhakuli wants to know
paragraphs_en: Chhakuli goes to grandma asking, ‘ Daadi ! Daadi! All day long, what do you do? What do you do?’ I look after the pets and plants I take care of all their wants I pour them love and they all share I sit and smile on my armchair. Why don’t you sing for me something new? Okay, darling, just for you.

Chhakuli goes to Bhaiya asking ‘ Bhaiya ! Bhaiya! All day long, what do you do? What do you do?’ I wake up early and go for a jog I chat with my friends, we laugh and talk when it's time, I walk to school we read and we write, it's all so cool I do my homework and go to play That is how I end my day Why don’t you fold your clothes? Is that not cool? Oh yes, darling, now I would.

Chhakuli goes to Doggy asking, ‘ Ludo ! Ludo! All day long, what do you do? What do you do?’ Bow Boww , Bow Boww Bowww Bow Boww , Bow Boww Bowww That sounds like a lot of work. Why don’t you dance with me? Bow Boww , Bow B oww B owww

Chakuli goes to Papa asking ‘ Papa ! Papa ! All day long, what do you do? What do you do?’ I run a shop in the marketplace So many customers, I daily face I give them goods, they pay me money That’s how the shop runs, honey Why don’t you do the dishes? Is that not work? Hmm D arling, I think I should.

Chhakuli goes to Mommy asking, ‘ Mommy ! Mommy ! All day long, what do you do? What do you do?’ I get up and pray before the sun I bathe and I cook for everyone I clean the house and I clean you up I keep an eye when you play with the pup I wash the clothes and get them pressed I make sure, you’re all well dressed I go to sleep when there’s no more task But, Chhakuli , my dear, why do you ask? Oh my god! So much Work. All the time. For a while, w hy don’t you just chill? Haha... Darling, now I will.
